note: Written and committed BEFORE any LV15 number was run. Revision C of the LV13 base design = revision B (LV13 model, 310 MVAr reactor at the 220 kV onshore bus in every case) with the cables LV14 sized, re-sized on the conservative soil value. Do not edit after the first run without a new revision and a reason.

decisions.D1: Sizing margin: cables are sized on soil thermal resistivity 1.5 K m/W (the LV14 sensitivity value) instead of 1.0, until a survey replaces it. This gives 800 mm2 array and 630 mm2 export from LV14's own sensitivity table. Proposed by Claude, 27 Oct 2026, for Jack's approval.
decisions.D2: LV13 revision C: yes. The load flow uses the sized cables' resistance at 90 C and capacitance from LV14's cable model; reactance and lengths unchanged from LV13 (A07, A11). Ratings are those at soil 1.5 K m/W.
decisions.D3: The minimum-fault ordering check joins the grading pass rule; R4 TMS 0.35 (LV14 what-if). The 3.9 s backup time this gives at the maximum offshore 66 kV fault is reported as a finding, not accepted silently.
decisions.D4: No datasheets or survey exist: every input stays ASSUMED and the report says so in its first paragraph.

question: Which single outages (N-1) can the 400 MW connection ride through at full output inside limits, and for each that cannot, what is the largest output that stays inside limits?

limits.basis: Same as LV13 revision A. Author's design criteria, NOT SOURCED to a standard or the Grid Code; the SQSS and Grid Code were not read.

intact_rule: Cases C1 to C4 (LV13 criteria.json) converge and are inside limits on revision C. An exception is reported with its computed cause; the PCC overvoltage of C4 found in LV13 and LV14 is expected and is reported, not fixed.

outages.what: the first section of string 1 (A1_1) out: string 1's eight turbines disconnected

n1_rule: For each outage and each case C1 to C4: run at the case's output. If inside limits, RIDES THROUGH. If not, find by bisection (1 MW) the largest total output, all in-service turbines scaled equally at the case's power factor, that is inside limits: that is the CURTAILED output. Voltage-only exceptions at C4 (light load) are reported as voltage exceptions, since curtailing cannot cure an overvoltage from cable charging. Remedies appear only as labelled what-ifs.

checks.what: generation minus power into the grid equals total branch loss
with one export circuit out at C1, the remaining circuit current is close to the intact two-circuit total (within 5 percent), by hand from the intact flow
the curtailed output with one 250 MVA OSS transformer out is within 5 percent of 250 MVA times the case power factor minus the array losses, by hand
maximum fault levels on revision C cables against LV14 (revision B): the change is reported, and LV14's grading verdicts are re-checked if any busbar changes by more than 2 percent
